name: Focus Trap
description: Keeps Tab and Shift+Tab focus cycling within a container and restores focus when deactivated.

anatomy.description: The div that listens for Tab and queries its own focusable descendants.
The focusable children cycled by Tab and Shift+Tab while the trap is active.

dos: Activate the trap only while the modal region is open.
Keep the default focus restoration so focus returns to the trigger on release.
Guarantee at least one focusable element inside the trap.
donts: Don't trap focus in normal page flow; keyboard users get stranded.
Don't run two active traps at once; coordinate which region owns focus.
Don't use it as a substitute for Dialog's full modal semantics.

examples.title: Toggleable trap
examples.description: Activate the trap around a panel; Tab cycles through its controls and focus returns to the toggle when released.

examples.title: Always-on trap
examples.description: A permanently trapped region such as an embedded modal pane or a guided form.

guidance.useWhen: A transient modal region — a dialog, drawer, or edit mode — must keep keyboard focus inside until it is dismissed.
guidance.avoidWhen: The content is part of the normal page flow; trapping focus there would strand keyboard users. Use a plain container instead.
guidance.behavior: While active, Tab on the last focusable element wraps to the first and Shift+Tab wraps the other way; with no focusable children Tab is suppressed entirely.
guidance.responsive: Renders a plain div with no intrinsic layout, so the trapped region adapts to whatever container styles you apply.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the next control, wrapping from the last back to the first.
Moves focus to the previous control, wrapping from the first back to the last.

notes: When the trap activates, focus moves to its first focusable element if focus was outside.
On deactivation or unmount, focus returns to the element that had it before the trap activated (disable with restoreFocus={false}).

props.description: Whether the trap currently holds focus.
props.name: active

props.description: Content whose focusable descendants are trapped while `active`.
props.name: children

props.description: Return focus to the previously focused element when the trap deactivates or unmounts.
props.name: restoreFocus
